summary: A shared 80-deep cross-section on every plot: a cream-white calcite arcade bar (z 3..14, 8-block bays of round arches with a window above each, cornice and balustrade at y 29), a 49-wide nave under a low deepslate roof with a glazed monitor ridge at y 38, and a grey andesite bay bar. Plot 0 adds a smooth-quartz pavilion with three tall arches, 2 blocks proud, and a 15-wide tower rising to y 70 with four 11-wide clock dials, then two arched belfry stages that step in, a lantern, a dome and a flagpole at y 103. Plot 2 adds a taller corner block where the arcade turns onto the east face, plus grey halls with lunette gables. It reads as the Ferry Building because the white clock tower stands over the long arcade with the dark roof behind.
